title: The Hidden Trapdoor
text: The floor gives way with a crack of old timber under the one with the most weight on their back. They drop into the dark with a shout. The rest of you follow, sliding down a stone chute into a shorter, darker passage that reeks of whatever lives there.

options.label: Down you go, after them, into whatever waits below.

outcomes.text: You land hard at the bottom of the chute. The way ahead is shorter, but whatever lives down here heard you arrive.
